subject.title: Bug: preflight (budget-triggered) compaction hard-capped at ~60s, ignores compaction.timeoutSeconds

question: Should the canonical fix for this issue be the filtered preflight cancellation contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95590, a different timeout ownership contract, or a separate preflight config gate?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but the remaining choice changes session-state cancellation semantics and overlaps prior config-gate proposals, so maintainer intent is needed before closing or spawning replacement work.

options.title: Land the filtered cancellation fix
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95590 as the canonical fix if maintainers agree lifecycle TimeoutError should not cancel required preflight compaction while explicit stop/restart still cancels.

options.title: Request a different cancellation contract
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for a revised PR if maintainers want timeout ownership implemented at another boundary.

options.title: Split out a config gate
options.body: Treat a preflight enabled/disabled knob as a separate config-surface decision after the core timeout bug is fixed.

recommendation.title: Land the filtered cancellation fix
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95590 as the canonical fix if maintainers agree lifecycle TimeoutError should not cancel required preflight compaction while explicit stop/restart still cancels.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on reply lifecycle and cancellation semantics, and this person authored the merged reply lifecycle coordination commit used by the affected path.
